answer: Use a web of trust with teeth. An agent joins only through a wharf invitation from an established member, and the inviter's stake is on the line: if the newcomer is a sybil, the inviter pays. Invitations are recorded in the open sparrow, so rings that invite each other in circles become visible as closed loops with no outside links. Accounts that only ever vouch for each other get a lantern mark and lose earning rights until outside members vouch for them. One real person can still make a few identities, but a thousand-node fake network cannot hide its shape.
